title: Nice mixer but ….
text:
Nice mixer but ….. I was excited about this mixer and I bought it for my daughter. It doesn’t mix well if the batter mixture is on the slightly thicker side or what you are mixing is a small amount . The problem is the beaters push the batter to the bottom and sides and it doesn’t touch those areas. You have to stop and stir quite a bit . Maybe a bowl redesign or a beater redesign would be helpful. We tried to beat egg whites and it doesn’t get close to touching 2-3 egg whites at the bottom ! There are some batters it works great on , as long as the batter is thin and there is enough of it , however we still have to stop to stir to get the batter that is at the side or bottom . Even a simple cake mix batter has issues.
I contacted Cuisinart to see if there were rubber edge beaters I could purchase that would work better and the response was “ no “. ( I did try my Kichenaid rubber edge beaters ( which fit! ) however the problem was still there as they did not touch batter on the bottom or sides. )

description: Delivering power, precision and performance, our newest stand mixer features a 500-watt motor, die-cast metal construction, and 12 speeds that allow for nuance and excellence in performing a variety of preparation tasks. The unit's tilt-back head allows for easy access to its 5.5-quart mixing bowl, while the included splash guard prevents messy countertops. Also included are a chef's whisk, dough hook, and flat mixing paddle. The mixing bowl and all accessories are dishwasher safe, and the stand mixer is available in red, white and brushed chrome. Additionally, you can purchase a variety of attachments for the unit: a pasta roller and cutter, pasta extruder, meat grinder, and frozen dessert maker.
